## Readable tray icon

- The country code in the tray icon is now drawn as large as the icon allows, with sharp edges at every display scaling.
- When several installed layouts share a country code, the icon shows dots under the code ("US" with two dots)
  instead of a hard-to-read number ("US2"). The tooltip still shows the full layout name.

To update, download `KeyboardLayoutSwitcher.exe` and run it; it replaces the installed copy.
